subject: gk
question: Under which of the following Writs can the Supreme Court and the High Courts call for the record of a case from a lower court or semi - judicial body on an allegation of an excess of jurisdiction?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Certiorari**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Certiorari** is one of the prerogative writs in the Indian legal system, primarily issued by higher courts to lower courts or tribunals.
 
• This writ is issued when a higher court wants to review the judgment or decision of a lower court or tribunal.
 
• It is used to correct errors of jurisdiction or when a lower court acts beyond its powers.
 
• The purpose of Certiorari is to ensure that the judicial decision-making process is conducted fairly and within the bounds of the law.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mandamus**

 
 
• It is a writ issued by a superior court commanding a lower court, tribunal, or public authority to perform a mandatory duty correctly.
 
• Mandamus is used to enforce the performance of public duties by authorities.
 
 
 
• **Prohibition**
 
 
• It is a writ issued by a higher court to a lower court or tribunal to stop them from proceeding with a case that exceeds their jurisdiction.
 
• It aims to prevent an inferior court from acting beyond its powers.
 
 
 
• **Quo Warranto**
 
 
• This writ is issued to challenge the legality of a person's claim to a public office.
 
• It questions the authority by which a person holds a public position.
